CERTIORARI -- SUMMARY DISPOSITIONS
25-390 ) FULL PLAY GROUP, S.A. V. UNITED STATES, ET AL.
)
25-396 ) LOPEZ, HERNAN V. UNITED STATES, ET AL.
The petitions for writs of certiorari are granted. The
judgment is vacated, and the cases are remanded to the United
States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit for further
consideration in light of the pending motion to dismiss the
indictment.
25-5067 ZIELINSKI, KIRA K. V. UNITED STATES
The motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma
pauperis and the petition for a writ of certiorari are granted.
The judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the United
States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit for further
consideration in light of the position asserted by the Solicitor
General in his brief for the United States filed on November 13,
2025.
